Package index

Prepare data

Build a STICS workspace from SMS data and run the simulations of a STICS version on it.

gen_workspace_from_sms()
Generate a Stics workspace from SMS data, for evaluation and calibration.
read_usms_files()
Read one or more USM list files.
get_var_from_obs()
Derive variable names from observation data
run_simulations()
Run Stics simulations for a text workspace.

Evaluate simulations

Compare a STICS version against observations and a reference version, and check balance closure.

evaluate()
Run All Evaluations
balance_closure_test()
Run the Balance Closure Test

Reports and plots

Visualize the evaluation results.

plot_rrmse_comparison()
Plot the rRMSE comparison
overview_heatmap()
Overview heatmap of the species-level status of every variable
usm_ratio_heatmap()
Heatmap of the per-USM RMSE ratio
render_report()
Render an HTML evaluation site
